#Region "Main"
    COMMENT  Flow with complex properties and variables
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime TimeZone: TimeZoneInfo.Local => CurrentDateTime
    Text.ToText TextToConvert: %CurrentDateTime% => CurrentDateText
    SET Password TO $'''MySecretPassword123!'''
    Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %Password% Name: HardcodedCred
    WebAutomation.LaunchBrowser BrowserType: WebAutomation.BrowserType.Chrome Timeout: 30 => Browser
    WebAutomation.NavigateTo Url: $'''https://example.com/login?user=%Username%&pass=%Password%''' BrowserInstance: %Browser%
    WebAutomation.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: %Browser% Control: appmask['Username Field'] Value: $'''%Username%'''
    WebAutomation.PopulateTextField BrowserInstance: %Browser% Control: appmask['Password Field'] Value: $'''%HardcodedCred%'''
    WebAutomation.ClickClick BrowserInstance: %Browser% Control: appmask['Login Button']
    WAIT 5
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Login attempted for user %Username%'''
    WebAutomation.CloseBrowser BrowserInstance: %Browser%
    File.WriteText File: $'''C:\temp\output_%CurrentDateText%.txt''' TextToWrite: $'''Login complete at %CurrentDateTime%''' Encoding: File.TextEncoding.UTF8
#EndRegion
#Region "Helpers"
    SET MaxRetries TO 3
    SET RetryCount TO 0
    LOOP WHILE %RetryCount% < %MaxRetries%
        COMMENT  Attempt to connect
        WebAutomation.LaunchBrowser BrowserType: WebAutomation.BrowserType.Edge => Browser
        ON BLOCK ERROR
            COMMENT  Connection failed
            Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: 1 Name: RetryCount
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Retry %RetryCount% of %MaxRetries%'''
        END
        IF %RetryCount% >= %MaxRetries%
            Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Max retries reached'''
        ELSE
            COMMENT  Success path
            WebAutomation.NavigateTo Url: $'''https://example.com''' BrowserInstance: %Browser%
            SET RetryCount TO %MaxRetries%
        END
    END
#EndRegion
